title: The Ossuary Collapse
text: The catacombs under the cathedral have given way. Ten generations of the city's dead have come up through the floor in a slope of bone, and they are still moving, very slowly, uphill. The masons need stone to seal it and iron to pin it shut.

temptation.label: Send your servants to pick over the bones for rings.
temptation.text: The dead were buried with their jewellery. They will not miss it, but they will remember who took it.

triumph.text: The ossuary is sealed with a new vault. The bishop reads the name of every dead soul over it; it takes a month, but the dead lie still.

holds.text: The ossuary is sealed, roughly. On quiet nights the cathedral floor creaks as if something underneath is turning over.

falters.text: The seal cracks within a week. At night the dead walk the lower town looking for their own houses, so the living move out of them.

calamity.text: The bone slope reaches the street. The dead walk into every Seat to lie down in the beds, and none of them can be moved without a fight.
